tools.description: List the court deadline types 1Court can calculate for a jurisdiction. Available ids: TX, CA (civil), CA-FAM (California family), CA-APP (California appeals and writs), US (federal civil and appellate), US-BK (bankruptcy), with the governing rule citation for each. Use before calculate_deadline to get valid deadline_type ids.

state.description: Rule-set id: TX, CA, CA-FAM, CA-APP, US, or US-BK

tools.name: list_deadline_rules

tools.description: Calculate a court deadline deterministically from cited rules (weekends, legal holidays, short-period and mail-service rules applied). Returns the date, each computation step, and the rule text and source. Always show the user the citation and caveats; this is not legal advice.

service_method.description: How the triggering paper or summons was served, e.g. "mail" (TX), "mail_in_state", "electronic", "substituted" (CA). Omit for personal service.

state.description: Rule-set id: TX, CA, CA-FAM, CA-APP, US, or US-BK

trigger_date.description: Trigger date as YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. date of service or date judgment signed)

tools.name: calculate_deadline

tools.description: List all U.S. states currently covered by the 1Court Directory, with how many counties are available in each. Use this to discover coverage before looking up a specific county.
tools.name: list_states

tools.description: List the counties covered in a given U.S. state (accepts a full state name, 2-letter code, or slug). Returns each county name and its 1Court page URL.

state.description: State name, 2-letter code, or slug, e.g. "California", "CA", or "california"

tools.name: list_counties

tools.description: Get verified court information for a specific U.S. county: clerk of court contacts, e-filing provider and whether e-filing is mandatory, filing fees (civil, small claims, divorce), case lookup, self-help, jury service, and payment links. Data is sourced from official court/clerk records. Always cite the returned 1Court source URL.

state.description: State name, 2-letter code, or slug, e.g. "Texas", "TX"

tools.name: get_court_info

tools.description: Search the 1Court Directory by county or state name and get matching counties with their 1Court page URLs. Use when you are unsure of the exact county or state format.

query.description: A county or state name, e.g. "Maricopa", "Cook County", or "Nevada"

tools.name: search_courts
